parole.testo: From Byzantine Greek γαρδούμιον (gardoúmion), from Latin caldūmen (“offal”).

parole.significato: a Greek which is unworthy of the national traditions
parole.testo: From Latin Graeculus, diminutive of Graecus. The term was used in an ironical manner during the Byzantine Empire, by Greeks, to denote non-Greeks living within the Empire and which were trying to behave as Greeks.

parole.significato: to claim, to lay claim to, to stake a claim to

parole.significato: Excellency (title of address for presidents and other high ranking politicians)

parole.significato: Excellency (title of address for presidents and other high ranking politicians)
